column7: Router-level companion of mixed-request-split-001: the same mixed requests over the real HTTP, SCIM and gRPC stack with LogAuditEvent#1..n refused. Each must show a partial apply with the machine-readable 503 / Unavailable body, the narrow-only state, no row of the second commit and every pinned owed row written or queued once, converge after the backfill and complete on retry; the probed owed types must equal owedAuditSplitExpectedOwedTypes. TestOwedAuditSplit_Calibration shows the verdict red/green. Red on a675a36c: 9/9 scenarios red (eight never produce a partial apply, the reissue fails the verdict).
